title: RagSource
description: One element of the SearchResponse.sources array. On the RAG path, built per DOCUMENT (deduped) in search/app/nodes/answer.py. On the QA path (2026-08-24) it is the curator's citation from qa_entries.asset_refs and carries ONLY rank + title + url — there is no document behind it, so file_uuid and the file-name keys are absent. EXTENSIBLE like its parent (2026-08-13): a client ignores keys it does not know, and must treat everything below rank/title as optional.

rank.description: 1-based document order in the context (top SOURCES_TOP_N documents, default 3).

title.description: User-friendly link text: the URL for a web page, else a cleaned original file name (UUID prefix + extension stripped, underscores→spaces).

url.description: Clickable link (source_url) or null for an uploaded file with no source URL.

file_name.description: Stored file name (may carry a UUID prefix).

source_url.description: Origin URL when ingested from the web.
